turns.assessment: The affected services all depend on the S08–S21 lightpath (och8), while protected services using that working route can remain OK after SNCP switching. The channel is normal at the S06 monitor from S23 but sharply power-degraded at S21 on the line from S06; aggregate power and pump telemetry for every S06→S21 amplifier is unchanged. This localizes a channel-specific attenuation fault to the S06 ROADM WSS rather than the span, amplifiers, or S21 receiver.

proposals.rationale: A single-channel WSS attenuation drift at S06 explains the 9.6-level channel-power drop downstream at S21, the associated OSNR/BER degradation at trx.och8.z, normal reception into S06 from S23, unchanged aggregate S06→S21 amplifier telemetry, and degradation of all unprotected services carried by och8.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

clarify.assessment: The affected signal is channel 36 arriving at S21 from S06, where O4/O5 show its power and OSNR degradation. Therefore the matching S06 WSS channel is oms.S21-S06|36; the other candidates have either the wrong channel or the wrong degree.

llm_alone.decision: commit after choosing one of 3 locations
